I desperately wanted to love this, but it is a classic example that bigger isn't always better.

This week’s A Play, A Pie, A Pint, written by Rob Drummond and Dave Hook , brings us a slick and thought-provoking hip-hop musical comedy with the life (or myth) of 13th-century Scottish legend and freedom fighter William Wallace at the centre of its conversation.

cn.t: This hip-hop musical about William Wallace draws mostly positive reviews for its thought-provoking take on Scottish legend, though some critics feel the expanded runtime dilutes its original punchy impact.
